summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Bob Shad, an American record producer and record label owner. It gives his birth name, birth and death dates, and notes that he produced the first album by Big Brother and the Holding Company, featuring Janis Joplin. It also names three of his more successful labels: Time Records, Brent Records, and Mainstream Records.
one_line: Bob Shad was an American record producer and label owner (1920–1985) known for producing Big Brother and the Holding Company's first album.
